kyrgyzstan.title: Flag of the Kyrgyz Republic

colors.note: Represents bravery and valour, and alludes to the banner of Manas the Noble
The sun and tündük representing light, peace, and the traditional yurt

desc:
- Red field with a yellow sun of 40 rays at the centre, overlaid with a stylised red tündük (the roof-ring of a yurt)
- Adopted on 3 March 1992 after independence and revised in 2023 to straighten the sun's rays
trivia:
- The 40 rays of the sun represent the 40 Kyrgyz tribes united by the legendary hero Manas
- The tündük is the wooden crown of a yurt through which smoke escapes and sunlight enters, symbolising origin and home
- In 2023 parliament straightened the rays (from wavy to straight) to resemble sun rays rather than, as some critics said, sunflower petals
